If a Barkers product does not work out for you, here are your options:

For online orders, you can return items within 30 days of delivery for a change of mind. Use the free prepaid courier label or return the item to a Barkers store or the online returns centre.
For in-store purchases, returns for a full refund are accepted within 14 days of purchase. Between 14 and 30 days, you may exchange the item or receive store credit.
Exchanges for a different size or style are available both online and in-store. For online exchanges, use the returns courier label and include the Returns/Exchanges Form. For in-store exchanges, bring the item and proof of purchase.
Items must be in original, unwashed condition with all labels attached. Worn, washed, damaged, or altered items cannot be returned for change of mind.
Proof of purchase is required. For online returns, your order details are used. For in-store returns, bring your receipt or Barkers can look up your loyalty account.
Refunds are processed to the original payment method. Gift card payments are refunded to the gift card, and Barkers Dollars are returned to your account. Barkers coupons are non-refundable.

If your item is faulty, Barkers will assess it and may offer a repair, replacement, refund, exchange, or store credit depending on the issue.
